_comment: MSOP content manifest - consumed by the MSOP Configurator app and MESH app. Declares where the MSOP-owned packages live: the final MSOP Configurator self-update zip, the MSOP Plugin (stable/beta), Hook Of The Reaper (stable/beta), MAMEhooker (stable/beta), the MSOP Database Compiler, the list of MSOP supported games (games.json), and the MSOP changelog (changelog.json).

Configurator._comment: The final MSOP Configurator (v1.1.0) self-update zip. Present so a hotfix can still be shipped to users who have not yet migrated to MESH: update this location (or set AssetUrl to a Release asset) and existing installs pick it up on the next self-update - no new app build required. Version comparison still uses changelog.json; this only says WHERE the latest Configurator zip lives. MESH ignores this ref.

Changelog._comment: The MSOP changelog. If used with MESH, this will merge the MSOP related changelog details into the MESH Changelog tab (the app/Configurator history comes from MESH's mesh-changelog.json, so any MSOP Configurator section here is ignored).
